name: Identity Provider
description: An identity provider (IdP) — also called an SSO provider, OAuth/OIDC or SAML authority, Okta/Auth0/Entra ID/Keycloak, or token issuer — that authenticates principals and issues tokens or assertions consumed across the system. The hub of federated trust and single sign-on. The place to look for the IdP, SSO/federation authority, OAuth/OIDC/SAML provider, or the service that authenticates users and issues tokens.
